reason: E.1 and E.4 name states (a non-member role on the smoke row; an administrator with two-step sign-in) that no interface creates, so a literal validator was blocked. The actions and expected results are reachable and correct; only the fixture instruction is missing.

changes.before: The test account row exists but its role is not `member`: `POST /api/production-smoke/account` returns HTTP 409 ...
changes.after: Precondition (validator's own throwaway test database only, never production): after creating the account, run `UPDATE users SET role='admin' WHERE email='smoke-member@test.saltbasin.invalid'` with psql. Then `POST /api/production-smoke/account` returns HTTP 409 ... (rest unchanged; screen checks at 1280px and 390px).
changes.tracesTo: Change spec: the route refuses (409) when the row is not a plain member; server/lib/smokeAccount.js readySmokeAccount.
changes.whyNeeded: The role fixture is only reachable through the database by design (nothing in the platform changes a role); the spec did not say how to build it.

changes.before: The administrator used by the provisioning workflow has two-step sign-in: scripts/provision-smoke-account.mjs exits 2 and prints ...
changes.after: Precondition (test database only): as that administrator, POST /api/auth/totp/setup, then POST /api/auth/totp/enable with the 6-digit code computed from the returned secret by totpCode() in server/lib/totp.js. Then scripts/provision-smoke-account.mjs exits 2 and prints ... (rest unchanged).
changes.tracesTo: Change spec exit-code table for the provisioning script; server/routes/auth.js totp routes (lines 127, 134).
changes.whyNeeded: The state is reachable through the documented API; the spec did not say how. The missing enrollment screen is a separate pre-existing gap outside this feature.
